# FG-AGENT-0006

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `promote_of_a_revoked_version_is_refused` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: この部品の版は取り消されています。取り消した版は戻せません。新しい版を公開してください。
- en: This part version has been revoked. A revoked version is final: publish a new version.
- id: Versi bagian ini telah dicabut. Versi yang dicabut bersifat final: terbitkan versi baru.

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 16 A5 (ADR-0032 Amendment A5): a promotion (`POST …/versions/{v}/promote`) or a second revocation (`POST …/versions/{v}/revoke`) named a version whose state is `revoked` (a revoked version is final, the A3 guard). `reason`: `revoked`. Nothing was changed. From A7 the builder and `forge/agent-lock` raise the same code when a lock names a revoked version.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The route's log event carries `slug`, `version` and `request_id`; `gstn part view <slug> <version>` shows the state, who revoked it and why.

## 対処 (fix)

Nothing on the server: publish a fixed version with a new version number (a revoked version is never restored), and promote that one.
